ai-vendor-checklist v1.1.0

- Initial release with a 10-point AI vendor due diligence checklist (data ownership, training opt-out, retention, qualifications, incident reporting, subprocessors, data export, model cards, audit, and transfer/exit).
- Provides checklist generation with --template and scoring with --score; returns rc=1 for scores below threshold.
- Zero dependency (stdlib only); cross-platform support for Windows, Linux, and macOS.
- Clarifies boundaries: does not replace professional judgment or official compliance interpretations.
- Includes usage guide, exit codes, FAQ, and installation instructions.
